column4: The base addresses of the two I-O location tables are contained in the value fields of the half
words at SBAPP and SBAMCP, for PP and MCP respectively.
The reel pool table consists of one full word entry for each reel which is requested by the
problem program. The table is set up at job control. Its format is as follows:
Address of the next reel table entry for the same unit.
It is zero if no more reels are to be mounted.
Count of the read instructions issued to this reel.
Count of the control instructions issued to this reel.
Count of the write instructions issued to this reel.
Count of the unit errors of this reel.
Count of the data errors of this reel.
